summary: Full 4-component vector blend: computes a2 + (a3 - a2) * broadcast(low element of a5) + (a4 - a2) * broadcast(low element of a6), stores the result into the first argument a1, and returns a1. The two scale values come from the low elements of a5 and a6 respectively.

operations.description: Load the four input vectors: base a2, sample a3, and sample a4.
Compute the bilinear blend a2 + (a3 - a2) * broadcast(low element of a5) + (a4 - a2) * broadcast(low element of a6); the ABI name labels this a bilinear interpolation.
Store the blended 4-float result into the output vector *a1.
Return the output vector pointer a1.
